changes.title: Invite wakes
items: Throwing a 💌 at a wild animal wakes its whole area: its young and adults stop watching (or wake from their naps) and come for you straight away

changes.title: Soundsystem generator
items: Every area's soundsystem is its own now: grown from a generator, no two alike, turned towards the dancefloor and bigger the further out it stands
Each has a projector on top, and as it's hurt it cracks, loses blocks and finally collapses in three stages before it falls

changes.title: Home speakers
items: Home is now its ring of 12 speakers, 500 health each: animals attacking home go for the nearest speaker still standing and knock them out one by one, and home only falls when all 12 are down
